featured.name: RAG Lab
featured.tagline: Learn RAG by watching it work.
featured.description: An interactive, local-first lab for every decision in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline: chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval, reranking, generation and evaluation. Every algorithm is drawn as it runs, including the HNSW graph traversal, cosine-similarity heatmaps and the final scoring radar.
featured.imageAlt: Animated demo of RAG Lab chunking, embedding and retrieving a document

run.requirements: Python 3.10+ and Node.js 18+. No API keys or cloud accounts.
steps: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev

featured.name: Do Not Fret
featured.tagline: A guitar practice app that plays along with you.
featured.description: A daily practice routine with a metronome and fretboards that light up each note on the beat, 27 theory lessons from the notes on the neck to improvising, songs with tab play-along, and charts of your clean tempo over time. One HTML file, no account; your log stays in your browser.
featured.imageAlt: Do Not Fret: a C major pentatonic exercise with a play-along fretboard

run.requirements: Any modern browser. Nothing to install.
steps: # or download do-not-fret/index.html and double-click it

featured.name: Body Lab
featured.description: A personal health aggregator that stitches Strava, Lose It and Apple Health into one dashboard, so training, nutrition and recovery can be read together instead of across three apps.
